text: The biopsy confirms pyoderma gangrenosum, a neutrophilic dermatosis often associated with your Crohn's disease. Since the lesion started after an ant bite, this is a classic example of pathergy, where minor trauma triggers the ulcer. We will need to manage this with immunosuppressive therapy rather than antibiotics or surgical debridement. DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyoderma Gangrenosum
